# The Temple of Spite

*Page PDF 13*

The Temple of SpiTe 

## **The Temple of Spite**
_Temple of Spite_ is a black ark, an enormous floating citadel that prowls the world’s oceans, propelled by a blend of sorcery and seamanship. Rising high above the waves, its jagged towers claw the sky, casting a forbidding silhouette that foreshadows a horrendous fate for any mariner unfortunate enough to encounter it on the high seas. 

## **The Fleetmaster**
Within the dark stone walls of the ark, a scheming, ruthless society jostles for power and survival. This community reflects that of Naggaroth, with rival factions vying for influence and advantage under the iron fist of the fleetmaster, Duriath Helbane. He is the scion of the infamous Helbane dynasty of Clar Karond, and rules the black ark as his personal fiefdom and vessel for his ambitions, seeking both to amass wealth and recruit a great warhost to strike at high elf outposts scattered across the world. Despite his schemes and despotic rule, Helbane’s grip on _Temple of Spite_ has weakened. A failed mutiny in recent years decimated the ark’s dark elf population, leaving it under-populated and Helbane vulnerable to another coup. 

## **The Corsair Fleets**
The black ark does not travel alone; it is accompanied by a fleet of vicious Druchii reavers, seafaring marauders who scavenge the oceans for prey and compete for riches and prestige. Their sleek ravenships are the bane of coastal settlements and merchant vessels, and many a ship has been plundered and burned, their crews killed or clapped in irons in the bowels of _Temple of Spite_ . 

These corsairs serve as Helbane’s eyes and ears. He can use them to project his power far from the ark, scouring the seas for opportunities and potential threats, while spreading dread in the name of Naggaroth and Malerion. 

## **From the Mists**
An encounter with the ark is truly terrifying, as it looms out of sorcerous mists, towering over even the tallest ship. _Temple of Spite_ may be faced almost anywhere on the world’s oceans, and none are safe from its dark power as the ark’s denizens leave its towers to explore, raid, and spy upon other species.
